evidence.reason: The dependency regex enumerates lifecycle/dependency directives but omits StopPropagatedFrom and PropagatesStopTo. A co-installed unit carrying StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service would escape detection, so stopping the fenced crq-tick unit could stop that co-tenant. The file already references systemd v257 semantics, so adding both names to the existing alternation is a routine correctness fix rather than a new requirement.
